cues.text: This little corner had been forgotten for years. I wanted to give it a new beginning.
cues.delivery: nhẹ, ấm, chậm vừa; như tự nhủ, không đọc kiểu quảng cáo

cues.text: I decided to start small. Just two beds for my first vegetables.

cues.text: For the first time, I could imagine what this place might become.
